scope: New synthetic nonlinear update-policy probe; no LM, original GRU substitution, GPU, cloud, or official test
qualification: Fixed candidate thresholds [.5,.7,.8,.9,.95,.99], >=64 accepted calibration steps, Wilson lower95>=.95; temporal dependence disclosed; loss-support guard; 10% independent audits.
pilot_stop: Any numerical qualification failure, nonfinite training, or 120 CPU seconds for the pilot. Inspect plain-backprop competence and all arms; no main decision until frozen main protocol.
hypothesis: A confidence-qualified forward-only updater can preserve learned primitive composition and earlier facts while replacing >=25% of main backward passes and reducing post-warmup CPU >=10%.
primary_comparator: hybrid versus backprop, paired by initialization and exact atomic training stream
primary_metric: Final two-operation composition accuracy difference (fraction correct); 512 exhaustive compositions per seed
success_rule: All three paired seeds satisfy quality limits; means meet both cost thresholds. Added-value evidence versus gated_skip requires >=.02 composition gain or >=.02 nats lower new-primitive CE. No broad language or architecture promotion from this probe.
futility_rule: Stop an arm on nonfinite values, failed frozen fidelity tolerance, integrity failure, or 120 CPU seconds per seed. Low acceptance and harmful always_hyper outcomes are retained; do not retune main.

authorization.reference: User 2026-10-17 18:10 America/Denver: Ok, cool - go ahead and proceed with the first experiments
authorization.resources: Current user-supplied workspace; CPU only; one thread per seed; three workers; 120 CPU s cap per seed; no external data, installs, spending, official tests, or cloud resources. Earlier Mac-SSD-only workflow does not describe this explicitly supplied environment.

control_rationale.gated_skip: Same confidence/support gate and predictor overhead, but no edit on accepted steps.
control_rationale.confidence_only: Learned confidence gate without calibrated loss-support guard; same sampled audit fallback. Added after pilot, before main.
control_rationale.always_hyper: Diagnostic applies every predicted update even when audited harmful.

design.warmup: 1200 concurrent predictor/gate training steps plus 256 frozen-controller calibration steps; separate exact plain-backprop warmup replay for startup cost.
design.predictor: Learned per-example low-rank update factors assembled into both complete affine-layer deltas; no model gradient input or autograd on accepted main updates.
design.controller_main: Frozen after warmup for this isolation study; two EMA summaries can change after audits. Joint ongoing controller adaptation is deferred.
design.model: 808 real coefficients, two fully represented Fourier parameter banks; tanh MLP 16->32->8. Explicitly new probe, not historical hierarchy.
design.seed_selection: Three new consecutive seeds fixed before any main run. Pilot 90917 excluded.
design.tuning: One shared LR .5 and configuration, unchanged after pilot; only confidence_only diagnostic arm added.
design.matching: Exact examples and starting learner per seed, not equal compute or total controller parameters.

data.atomic_facts: Eight random permutations on eight values; initial operators 0..3 then operators 4..7 one per 250-step phase. Main batches 50% new operator / 50% replay of previously introduced operators.
data.confirmation: Exhaustive 512 two-operation compositions; 2048 four-operation chains; 64 atomic facts. Atomic facts overlap training by design, combinations never receive training loss. A fixed external executor supplies composition order.
data.queries: Independent batch draws of current and initial operators for warmup qualification and 10% main audits; these are charged supervision, not free inference or withheld final tests.
data.region_reuse: New worlds and streams; existing pilot world excluded from main. Finite atomic-domain overlap is intentional.

training.optimizer: SGD .5 without momentum/weight decay for learner; Adam .001 for predictor/gate during first 1200 warmup steps only.
training.selection: Final checkpoint only; no main tuning or selection.
training.state: Curve weights persist across curriculum phases; controller EMA state initialized identically per arm. No token-context or learned multi-timescale hierarchy in this probe.

execution.hardware: CPU, no CUDA; one PyTorch thread per worker
execution.ownership: Unique run directory and exclusive creation of per-seed output; no archived run changed.
execution.baseline_step: Teacher factor extraction included in both plain and curve learner paths. Complete Fourier transform preserves all coordinates.
execution.timing: Measured process CPU and wall time; lifecycle includes independently measured appropriate warmup; three seed processes concurrent; isolated microbenchmark may follow after training.

evaluation.duplicate_policy: Reload every final checkpoint, verify hash, score twice and require identical metrics.
evaluation.uncertainty: All three paired results and descriptive mean/range; no asymptotic significance claim from n=3.
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: Only hybrid vs backprop primary; other contrasts explanatory/diagnostic.

evidence.checkpoints: Each main seed summary stores SHA256 before final confirmation.
evidence.progress: Per-arm traces plus logs; terminal receipts per seed.
evidence.preservation: Keep pilot source/results and all main source, checkpoints, scores, logs; package reproducible evidence.
evidence.registration: Locally frozen, not externally preregistered. Pilot protocol preceded pilot; shared registry is added after pilot and before main.
